body.name: \(\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}\)
body.construction: Apply order-\(K_n\) Taylor--Legendre outer enclosures to \(\varphi_{f,x}\) and \(\varphi_{q,x}\), truncate each error law by its second-moment tail envelope, replace each truncated law by positive atomic quadrature exact through order \(2K_n\), and run outward-rounded Bernstein interval branch-and-bound on \(\mathcal C_*\times I\) until every objective and constraint enclosure has radius at most \(\zeta_n\); \(\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}\) is the finite set of retained rational coefficient, quadrature, tail, and remainder boxes with their outward interval certificates.
